environment.description: Ktor 2.3.x microservice deployed on EKS cluster (us-east-1). The Split.io SDK is initialized with API key pointing to 'development' environment where the 'profile-enrichment-v2' flag treatment is set to 'on' for all traffic (100% rollout). No null-safety middleware or structured error boundary beyond the basic try-catch. The enrichment service cache is empty for most user IDs, causing null returns.
